import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w); print(e); print(g, w.groupby(['genre','late']).size().unstack())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); bs=[]
grp={k:v for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(2000):
  d=pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in grp.values()]); bs.append(est(d)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in [['high'],['high','medium']]:
  print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence.isin(dc)])[0])
print(est(w[w.year.between(1850,1900)])[0])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(w.groupby(['origin','late']).r.mean().unstack())
print(w[(w[c]>0)].sort_values('date_confidence').groupby('late').head(4)[['work_id','year','genre','late']])

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['y']=w[c];w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
m=smf.glm('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)',w,family=__import__('statsmodels.api').api.families.Binomial()).fit(cov_type='HC1');print(m.params['late'],m.bse['late'])
p['dt']=p.domains.apply(lambda a:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(a))
q=p[p.dt&(p.confidence>=0.9)].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(q[q.year>=1876].passage_id.head(5).tolist(),q[q.year<1876].passage_id.head(3).tolist())
